resize_geometry_2026_11_01.reported_trigger: Manjaro VM X11 and Wayland: edge drags or snapped sizes leave white/stale content; bottom resize edge missing. Workstation comparison does not show this.

live_read_only_evidence.method: Read-only X properties and matched Wine /proc structures. No live input, screenshot capture or debugger attachment.

diagnosis: The native 1024xwork-area minimum can reject smaller geometry already accepted by KWin, leaving the Win32 client rect and native edge hit-testing out of sync.
After permitting smaller geometry, independent stale-pixel failures can remain following resize/maximize transitions; a coalesced full repaint resolves the isolated comparison.
changes: Retain the normal startup size and work-area fit; permit subsequent native sizes down to 320x240 (or the smaller work area). Existing zoom fits the full logical UI.
Coalesce resize/resized/maximize/unmaximize into one full repaint 250 ms after the last event; cancel on minimize/hide/close. No continuous repaint, page reload or window-size nudge.
resize_geometry_2026_11_01.installer_integration: Existing verified prepare_frontend_startup transform, called by activate_frontend. No new host packages, runtime binary or compositor setting.
resize_geometry_2026_11_01.uninstall_scope: The transformed archive remains inside the receipt-owned private installation, removed by the existing uninstall transaction.

original_archive_validation.method: Same verified prepare_frontend transform invoked by activate_frontend during installation

isolated_validation.environment: Manjaro VM, private KWin X11 6.5.5 and virtual KWin Wayland 6.5.6 / Xwayland; llvmpipe LLVM 22.1.1 / Mesa 26.0.2-arch1; 1280x800 display.
isolated_validation.isolation: Disposable prefix/runtime copies, private PID/network/dev/display/session bus; no live desktop or physical input devices. Wayland compositor received only a render node for OpenGL screenshots.

comparison.repaint_only: 12/12 pixel checks passed, but native/client geometry remained inconsistent; insufficient on its own.

production_transform.compact_size_limit: Wayland reached 320x240. In the X11 tile fixture the WM retained the initial 756-pixel height; width reached 320. One unchanged X11 sample is excluded from transition totals.
production_transform.hit_test_result: WM_NCHITTEST = HTBOTTOM (15) at the displayed bottom border; displayed X11 and native Win32 sizes agreed in every measured snapshot.
production_transform.pixel_checks: Native drawable plus composed display captures retained page content and avoided large white/blank areas after each settled transition. Samples taken one second after the gesture, not a claim of artifact-free animation during dragging.
production_transform.successful_run_shutdown: Exit 0, no remaining prefix processes, installation inventory intact.

isolated_validation.excluded_attempts: Earlier fixture failures (stale clone inventories, capture helper signature, QPainter screenshot cancellation, inaccurate fixed button coordinates) are excluded. Synthetic XTEST button/edge input did not reliably initiate Wayland native actions; no pass is inferred from those no-ops.
isolated_validation.limits: Headless checks do not establish physical-GPU behavior, manual Wayland edge dragging, or complete fresh-install acceptance. No reliability percentage is inferred from these counts.
